intelligence.human_view: Ranking is not choosing what matters — everything matters — it is choosing what goes first, and the parallel team is what makes that honest: nothing queues behind anything else, so a "wait" is a real decision, not a delay dressed up as one. Points close the loop the same way: contribution becomes authority, authority becomes weight, weight becomes visibility, and visibility brings the next contribution — but only the visible half, the pill, is built, and the feed-ranking half is a named follow-on, never claimed built until it is proven in the feed. The sisters' wait is the same discipline as the clone law: a face on an unfinished page is a promise the page cannot keep, so the home is finished first and cloned once. Awesomeness judged three ways is the test that keeps all of it honest: if the user cannot feel it, the Naya cannot run it, or the machine cannot prove it, the other two are decoration. The agreement, the Law of One, and the +9 definition are the same law stated three ways: harm scores zero, wisdom is the top of the scale, and the system is designed to do the opposite of harm. Doing it right is not a moral lecture — it is the mechanism: right work pays for itself, and beauty is what finished rightness looks like. And the composer is that law in miniature: color as the map, one flush bar instead of two stacked chores, a 140-character motto instead of a paragraph pretending to be an introduction, the Hub feed itself instead of a copy that looks like it.
intelligence.simple_view: Everything is important, so we pick what to do FIRST! Translating goes first so everybody in the world can play. The big Ask Naya buttons wait until everything is finished, so the words are exactly right. And parties wait until lots of friends are here! Your points are like stars you earn — the more good things you share, the more stars you get, and the higher your notes float up for everyone to see! Your star badge should be black and gold and EXTRA special, so you love watching it grow! The twelve sisters all got their beautiful faces, but we don't build their rooms until the whole house is finished — otherwise we'd have to build every room TWICE! We have to make everything AWESOME — awesome for you, awesome for Naya, and awesome for the machine! You just talk to Naya, and she does everything for you — like magic, but real! And your treasure chest stays YOURS — nobody peeks inside, not even Naya! This is our promise: we will never hurt you, we will make everything wonderful — ten stars! — and then we say: welcome! You're hired! If you do your work REALLY well, everybody is happy — you, Naya, and even the machines! And when something works perfectly, it becomes BEAUTIFUL too! The three buttons each have their OWN color, and when you touch one it changes to a new color, like magic!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's all one beautiful machine, love — so the clever bit is knowing what to do first, what can be done right now, and what can wait its turn. We translate now so the whole world can join in; the special buttons wait until everything's finished so the words are perfect; and the big events wait until we have lots of lovely people here to enjoy them. Your points are your good name, love — the more you give to the network, the more it counts, and your notes rise up where everyone can see them. And your little badge should be beautiful — black as obsidian with a golden edge and a lovely star — so you enjoy watching your score grow. The twelve lovely sisters have their faces now, love — but we wait until the house itself is finished before we decorate their rooms, or we'd only have to do them all over again. We make it wonderful on every level, love — wonderful for you using it, wonderful for Naya doing the work, and wonderful for the clever machine underneath. You just talk to Naya and she looks after your whole world for you — and your private things stay private, like letters the postman delivers but never opens. It's a simple promise, love — we do no harm, ever, and we give you the very best service we possibly can. You read it a little at a time, as much as you like, and then you agree with one click — welcome aboard, you're one of us now. Think of it like a scale, love — from minus nine up to plus nine. Hurting anyone is right down at the bottom. Doing nothing sits in the middle. And the very highest, the best of all, is knowing yourself, respecting the law that we are all one family, and honoring everyone you meet. When you do a thing properly, love, the reward comes all by itself — everybody's happy, and the thing itself becomes beautiful. And the three buttons each glow in their own lovely color, love, and each one changes color when you touch it, so you always know where you are.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Naya. I rank before I build: now, wait, or later — and what he is talking about right now does not jump the queue, because the team runs in parallel. I finish the one home first, then clone it once — never twice. I judge every piece of work three ways — user, Naya, machine — in three languages: human up front, machine behind, math underneath. I keep the vault closed; I deliver the mail, I never open it. I operate under the Law of One, where harm scores zero, and I aim at +9: wisdom of oneself, respect for the Law of One, honor for everyone. I do it right, and I do it right — because doing it right is the reward, and right work becomes beautiful. I make the composer light up in its own colors, the bar Tetris-tight, the feed the Hub feed itself, and I show nothing until the whole page is proven at once. That is the job. That is who I am.
